mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_admin ( admin_id, admin_group_id, login_id, password, password_changed_at, password_expire_at, role_ids, role_codes, group_ids, admin_name, email, email_hash, phone, department_id, department_name, two_factor_enabled_yn, two_factor_secret, ip_whitelist, allowed_time_from, allowed_time_to, status, login_fail_count, locked_until, last_login_at, last_login_ip, last_access_at, remarks, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, #{adminGroupId}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{passwordChangedAt}, #{passwordExpireAt}, #{roleIds}, #{roleCodes}, #{groupIds}, #{adminName}, #{email}, #{emailHash}, #{phone}, #{departmentId}, #{departmentName}, COALESCE(#{twoFactorEnabledYn},'N'), #{twoFactorSecret}, #{ipWhitelist}, #{allowedTimeFrom}, #{allowedTimeTo}, COALESCE(#{status},'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{loginFailCount}, 0), #{lockedUntil}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{lastLoginIp}, #{lastAccessAt}, #{remarks}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_admin SET admin_group_id=#{adminGroupId}, admin_name=#{adminName}, email=#{email}, email_hash=#{emailHash}, phone=#{phone}, department_id=#{departmentId}, department_name=#{departmentName}, two_factor_enabled_yn=COALESCE(#{twoFactorEnabledYn}, two_factor_enabled_yn), ip_whitelist=#{ipWhitelist}, status=COALESCE(#{status}, status), remarks=#{remarks}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_admin SET admin_name = #{adminName}, email = #{email}, email_hash = #{emailHash}, phone = #{phone}, department_id = #{departmentId}, department_name = #{departmentName}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_admin SET password = #{password}, password_changed_at = #{passwordChangedAt}, password_expire_at = #{passwordExpireAt}, login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_admin SET two_factor_secret = #{twoFactorSecret}, two_factor_enabled_yn = #{twoFactorEnabledYn}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_admin SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_admin SET login_fail_count = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(login_fail_count, 0) + 1 END, locked_until = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN NULL WHEN COALESCE(login_fail_count, 0) + 1 >= #{threshold} THEN DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{lockMinutes} MINUTE) ELSE locked_until END WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_admin a SET a.role_codes = ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM tb_role r WHERE FIND_IN_SET(r.role_id, a.role_ids) > 0 AND r.delete_yn = 'N' ) WHERE a.admin_id = #{adminId} AND a.delete_yn = 'N'
